docs.text: Welcome to SAIEngine! This is the documentation for SAIEngine, where you can find an explanation of the general semantics for using the engine, as well as a full API reference. Features C++ backend with Lua scripting Unity-like actor, component, and scene management SDL3-powered rendering, audio, and input management Fluidsynth-powered live synthesis/MIDI playback using SoundFonts MIDI controller support for use as a synth controller or game input Portable design - works on Windows, Mac, and Linux machines How to Download/Use Download the latest release of SAIEngine for your platform here If you'd like, you can also build the project yourself by visiting SAIEngine's GitHub repo Create a resources folder adjacent to the downloaded executable This folder will contain all of your scenes, components, and assets Run the executable and watch your project come to life! How to Navigate the Docs The top navigation bar contains all the main sections of the documentation. Visit the "Semantics" section to learn about how exactly SAIEngine functions and core concepts it uses. Visit the "API Reference" section to see the various functions at your disposal.
